rationale: Proceed with the next Community-only implementation after the dark foundation was deployed and live-verified. This authorizes stages 2 through 4 only: narrow provider/toolbox support, a disabled n8n import before activation, distinct generated relay and identity secrets stored only in runtime configuration, the new opaque Community route, exact main-workspace Heartbeat registrations for the initial core shadow manifest (USER_JOIN, USER_UPDATE, GROUP_JOIN, and COURSE_COMPLETED), sanitized transport/duplicate/quarantine/replay canaries, daily read-only registration/catalog/membership/progress reconciliation, and natural dark receipt observation. The lifecycle catalog is owned by Tandem Coaching Academy operations with Alex Kudinov accountable; initial mappings must be exact course-only or exact cohort entries from refreshed Community inventory, never inferred commercial mappings. Retention defaults are 30 days for ingress, 7 days for failed-identity transient evidence, and enrollment close plus 24 months for operational state; grading text, feedback bodies, certificate URLs, messages, and payment detail remain excluded. This does not authorize legacy receiver deletion or cutover, ABANDONED_CART, DIRECT_MESSAGE, THREAD_CREATE, MENTION, EVENT_CREATE, EVENT_RSVP, or DOCUMENT_CREATE registrations, Circle access or changes, lifecycle actions/messages/certificates, Encharge changes, user/group/course mutations, manufactured Heartbeat student events, minion authority, or destructive rollback. Existing receivers remain unchanged throughout shadow capture.
